Name: Hudson Valley Stonybrook Tractors
Author: lanky2610
Description:
I was thinking about installing Pathoschild's amazing mod for tractors in the game, but they didn't fit in with the aesthetic mods that I had installed. So I took my first plunge into modding, and made my own!  Includes reskins of the garage for spring, summer, fall (autumn), and winter based off of Magimatica's Hudson Valley Buildings. I haven't touched the tractor, and only for the Stonybrook skins so far, as that is my favourite.

Simply unzip the contents of the folder into the TractorMod/assets folder included in Pathoschild's mod, and you should be good to go!

Tractor Mod made by Pathoschild found at: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401?tab=description
Hudson Valley Buildings - Complete Collection by Magimatica, oomps62 and endohare found at: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2110?tab=description
